# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in Boom Bap Producer Pads.

## This repo is the distribution repo

This repository holds finished builds (via [Releases](../../releases))
and user-facing documentation (`docs/`). It doesn't host active source
development — there's no `Source/` folder here to send a code PR against.

## Reporting bugs

Open an [issue using the bug report template](../../issues/new/choose).
Include your plugin version (from the Releases page), your DAW/host if
you hit it inside a DAW, and clear steps to reproduce. See
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead if what you found is a security
vulnerability rather than a regular bug.

## Requesting features

Open an [issue using the feature request template](../../issues/new/choose).
Describe the problem you're trying to solve, not just the solution you
have in mind — it helps us evaluate the request even if the exact
implementation ends up different.

## Fixing documentation

Typos, unclear steps, broken links in `docs/` — pull requests are welcome
for these. Keep the change focused; unrelated reformatting makes it
harder to review.

## Code of conduct

Participation in this project's issues and pull requests is covered by
our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
